overview_markdown:
CoPaw (formerly or also known as QwenPaw) is a personal AI assistant built in Python, designed for easy installation and deployment either on a user's own machine or in the cloud. It supports integration with multiple chat applications and offers easily extensible capabilities through tools and plugins, as seen in its v2.0.0 release that added web search/fetch tool chunks and memory session propagation.

The architecture emphasizes user-friendly setup and broad chat platform connectivity, differentiating from OpenClaw by its Python foundation and explicit multi-app support. Recent commits show active maintenance with bug fixes for memory summarization and desktop mode, indicating a healthy project trajectory.

While it shares OpenClaw's goal of a personal assistant for any platform, CoPaw's security posture and sandboxing are less documented, making it suitable for users prioritizing extensibility over hardened isolation.
